story.titleZh: 塞恩斯为威廉姆斯车队带来赛季首个Q3，巴库站将从P9起步
story.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队在X上庆祝卡洛斯·塞恩斯晋级Q3，这是车队本赛季首次进入Q3，他将在巴库站正赛从第9位发车。

relatedItems.titleZh: 威廉姆斯车队：比赛重启后发生碰撞，安全车再次出动
relatedItems.summaryZh: 第36圈（共51圈），比赛重启后发生碰撞，安全车再次出动，卡洛斯未受影响并升至第12位。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Lap 36/51 The safety car is back out after contact on the restart. Carlos is clear and up to P12.
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Lap 36/51
The safety car is back out after contact on the restart. Carlos is clear and up to P12.
detailZh: 第36圈（共51圈）。比赛重启后发生碰撞，安全车再次出动。卡洛斯未受影响并升至第12位。
detailEn:
Lap 36/51
The safety car is back out after contact on the restart. Carlos is clear and up to P12.
keyPointsEn: The race is 51 laps in total and the incident happened on lap 36

relatedItems.titleZh: 威廉姆斯车队通报：阿尔本撞墙退赛，安全车出动
